title: The Equivalence Principle
description: Drop a hammer and a feather on the Moon and they land together. Gravity pulls everything with the same acceleration, so in free fall gravity vanishes - Einstein's happiest thought. Unlocks the Proof Mass.

puzzle.goal: A hammer and a feather are dropped together from height h in a vacuum. They land at the same moment, because a body's inertia and its weight are always in proportion. Write how long t they take to reach the ground under acceleration g.
puzzle.name: Universality of free fall
puzzle.ask: Find t in seconds for the drop made on the Moon in 1971: h = 1.6 m, g = @{g} m/s².
puzzle.method: Starting from rest with constant acceleration, h = ½gt². The mass of the body appears nowhere.
